title: SAT Certificate Equivalence
statement: A binary string $x$ belongs to $\mathrm{SAT}$ if and only if there is a binary string $u$ with $|u|=|x|+1$ such that the concatenation $xu$ belongs to the plain-mode verifier language.
replaced:
A binary string $x$ belongs to $\mathrm{SAT}$ if and only if there exists a
certificate $u$ with $|u| = |x| + 1$ such that the concatenation
$x \mathbin{+\!\!+} u$ belongs to the plain-mode verifier language.
